name: Fubuki
configuration: Approved GameModels3D Fubuki (A); default paint; source-model fit, historical year unverified

structuralPlating.note: Estimated game protection; the reference does not establish armor thickness.

accuracy.exterior: Independent interpretation of approved GameModels3D pjsd106 A_Hull_1943. Scale and waterline provisional; historical year unverified.
accuracy.internals: Estimated rooms, machinery and magazines for gameplay; no internal reference plans.
accuracy.weapons: Approved source fit; mechanical stops and combat performance use provisional game conventions.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.
